component.name: OpenXplorer
component.summary: Explorer-style local and SMB file manager

description.p: Browse local folders, SMB shares and connected phones in a tabbed window styled after Windows 11 File Explorer, with light and dark appearances, a resizable sidebar, indexed filename search and ZIP browsing.

Installation does not change file associations, browser preferences or network mounts. Making OpenXplorer the default file manager, handling Show in folder requests and the other desktop integrations stay off until you turn them on in Settings.
Keep in-app updates working after the repository moves to the openxplorer GitHub organization.
Fix dragging filenames containing parentheses and simplify the Software updates dialog.
Place the update action beside the bottom-right view controls and remove the stable-release status indicator.
Display the native app layout immediately during startup instead of a centered message and spinner, while preserving startup recovery.
Add opt-in in-app updates and fix folder permission preservation, backup protection, keyboard activation, tab navigation, cached search and device ZIP extraction.
Add explicit Replace or Skip conflict handling and fix transfers to connected phones that do not support Unix permission changes.
Show connected Android, camera/PTP and iPhone devices in the sidebar and This PC, with native GIO browsing and hot-plug refresh.

First stable release. Middle-click folders to open tabs in the background, tear tabs out onto the desktop and merge them back across windows, extract ZIP archives and open terminals in the current folder. Existing defaults remain unchanged until requested.
